text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty auto-page fired — service=\"inference-gateway-usw2\" metric=5xx_rate spike > 5% over 5m. Incident created: INC-2026-0487. Paging rotation: oncall-alex -> sre-jihoon. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

pd-bot: PD incident INC-2026-0487 opened and sent to oncall-alex. Escalation timer: 15m.

oncall-alex: ack — I'm on it. Starting triage. Can someone confirm customer impact numbers?

sre-jihoon: looking at logs — upstream kv-proxy is returning a wave of 502s to the gateway. Error rate correlates with kv-proxy p95 latency spike ~320ms.

svc-eng-maya: noted. This matches a recent config roll on kv-proxy (small batch). If kv-proxy is unhealthy we should divert traffic to inference-gateway-eu1 as temporary mitigation. Runbook step 3 has the traffic-shift command.

oncall-alex: executing traffic shift (dry-run then apply).

```bash
# dry-run
infra traffic-shift --from inference-gateway-usw2 --to inference-gateway-eu1 --percent 20 --dry-run
# apply
infra traffic-shift --from inference-gateway-usw2 --to inference-gateway-eu1 --percent 20
```

oncall-alex: applied 20% shift to eu1. watching metrics.

platform-bot: autoscaler note: no scale events triggered in last 10m. Cluster util on usw2: 67%; eu1: 45%.

sre-jihoon: after 20% shift, 5xx dropped from 7.8% -> 3.4% within 2m. Suggest bump to 50% if we see continued improvement. Also tailing gateway logs shows KV error bursts from host kv-azb-03.

pm-lina: any customer-facing impact? Any high-volume customers affected?

oncall-alex: initial impact estimate — ~4% of requests getting 5xx during the 30m spike window. No major SSO customers reported. I opened a brief status note in status.redwood.com and flagged for updates.

sre-jihoon: bumping to 50% shift now.

```bash
infra traffic-shift --from inference-gateway-usw2 --to inference-gateway-eu1 --percent 50
```

oncall-alex: applied 50%. Monitoring: 5xx -> 1.1% and falling. Latency p95 back to normal on gateway.

incidentbot: Incident INC-2026-0487 updated: mitigation in place (traffic shifted), assigned engineers: oncall-alex, sre-jihoon, svc-eng-maya.

pd-bot: Escalation timer cleared. PD note added: temporary traffic diversion applied, root cause investigation in progress.

svc-eng-maya: I'm rolling back the kv-proxy config batch that went out 18m ago to remove the potential regression on kv-azb-03. Will monitor health probes.

platform-bot: kv-azb-03 marked for maintenance; kube drain scheduled: `kubectl drain kv-azb-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

oncall-alex: confirmed metrics stable for 10m at ~1% 5xx. Leaving the shift at 50% while we validate kv-proxy rollback and drain. I'll update the PD incident with a summary and ETA for closure. :white_check_mark:

pm-lina: thanks — please include customer impact numbers in the incident summary.

sre-jihoon: noted. We'll do a post-incident note with timeline, mitigation (traffic shift + rollback), and follow-ups (better canary gating for kv-proxy).

oncall-alex: closing the active page for now — will keep INC-2026-0487 open for RCA. If anything regresses ping me directly.
